adaptation_proposal.name: explicit_modality_and_network_policy_before_provider_fallback
contract: Declare input/output modalities and endpoint/network requirements separately from installation and authentication.
When local_only is required, providers requiring remote service or automatic download are ineligible; undeclared locality must not be treated as local.
Do not switch to gTTS/remoteVision/STT silently; return blocked/degraded with reason and preserve primary coordination.
Microphone, camera, ESP32 tools and runtime setup remain explicit separate actions.
acceptance_tests: Remote fallback rejected for local_only task even if provider filename contains local.
Unknown modality or undeclared locality fails closed.
Existing text workflow still routes without activating capture hardware.
Declared local provider still requires actual readiness evidence; no trust promotion from labels.

conclusion: Prefer selective contracts and one adapter per role; none of the five should replace the Core primary or be imported wholesale.
